verdict.rationale: Llama ships as downloadable open weights that run fully locally on desktop, mobile and edge devices (llama.cpp, ExecuTorch). That structurally keeps user data out of Meta's hands and therefore out of its training pipelines. However, nothing in the evidence states a no-training data policy, and nothing addresses opt-out for Meta's hosted chat or partner-hosted endpoints. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that user inputs are not used for training, a documented opt-out control for hosted Meta AI or partner APIs, and independent corroboration of the privacy posture.
